scope: Two pre-registered volatile official documentation URLs for CDC delivery semantics and Cross-Encoder inference efficiency; no source discovery was performed.

verified_claims: Debezium documents at-least-once delivery as its baseline guarantee: changes are not missed, but a record can be delivered more than once.

The guide states that Debezium does not implement an internal deduplication layer for exactly-once semantics, while source connectors deployed in Kafka Connect can use Kafka Connect exactly-once support in supported scenarios.
It presents exactly-once as a stricter requirement than at-least-once and therefore a deployment- and connector-dependent property.
records.boundary: Exactly-once participation is conditional on Kafka Connect configuration and connector support; it is not an end-to-end guarantee for downstream indexing or answer generation. Consumers must remain idempotent and test duplicate, retry and recovery paths.

verified_claims: Sentence Transformers documents float16 (fp16) inference for Cross-Encoder models as a GPU speed option with potentially minimal model-accuracy loss.
The page presents inference-speed optimization as a choice among precision and runtime backends, alongside the library's PyTorch, ONNX and OpenVINO deployment paths.
The Cross-Encoder efficiency guidance is intended for inference optimization after the two-stage retrieve-and-rerank design, not for replacing candidate-set or relevance evaluation.
records.boundary: Precision and backend effects depend on model, hardware, batch size and workload. The documentation's speed and accuracy trade-off must be benchmarked locally before changing production reranking behavior.
